job_description:
Job Title: Senior Embedded Software Engineer – Automotive Systems
Location: Milwaukee, WI
Duration: Long Term
Client: Clarios

Job Description & Skill Requirement:

• Automotive or other safety-critical experience with 8+ years of embedded systems software development.

• Experience with high voltage EV/HEV and/or low voltage Micro Hybrid systems is required.

• Experience with Matlab, Simulink, and Target link is mandatory.

• Experience with AUTOSAR architecture is desired.

• Experience with the Software V-Model and ASPICE.

• Experience with scripting languages such as Python, CAPL is desired.

• Experience in negotiating timing and software content with customers is desired.

• Excellent overall technical and communication skills.

• Excellent spoken and written English language skills.

Key Responsibilities:
• Technical leadership for detailed design and coding of embedded software modules.

• Lead and participate in software design and code reviews.

• Integration of software modules including application, low-level, and third-party software.

• Consulting and coaching of peers.

• Test software functions, components, and features/applications.

• Release of completed work products.

• Managing work through use of Configuration Management and Issue Tracking tools.

• Work with cross-functional teams to understand and define system hardware or control algorithms.

• Support creation and review of Software Requirement Specifications.

• Direct and lead less experienced engineers in the above tasks.
